claim_text: The voter registration website VoteSafe.org was funded by Elon Musk's America PAC and it collects and shares users' personal information.
query: The voter registration website VoteSafe.org was funded by Elon Musks America PAC
summary: America PAC, a pro-Trump Super PAC financed primarily by Elon Musk to transfer massive funding to Donald Trump's presidential campaign in 2024, has published a website called VoteSafe.org that falsely claims to help people register to vote ahead of the midterm election in November. The home page of Elon Musk's Vote Safe site with its listed political affiliation: Visitors to the site automatically transmit to Musk their: full name, birthday, home address, email address, cellphone number, IP address, browser, operating system, screen size and language of device, location, district, voter registration status, every link they click on, and every web page they visit. The site includes a lengthy privacy disclaimer page which informs users their personal data may be given to third parties for "targeted marketing purposes," and that contact information may be shared with "business partners." What is even more alarming is that VoteSafe.org is also tracking "inferences" that can be made about users based on their personal information.
